newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy slightly lowers '96 deficit/GDP ratio - source.
newsitem.headline: Italy slightly lowers '96 deficit/GDP ratio - source.

text.p: Italy's public administration deficit was 6.7 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) and not 6.8 percent as previously stated, a government source said.
The source said the deficit was 126.5 trillion lire last year, around one trillion lire better than expected.
He added that the quarterly accounts from this year pointed to a deficit of 74.301 trillion lire in 1997, or 3.8 percent of GDP, without further corrective budget measures.

The cabinet office said earlier in a statement that the government would unveil shortly a mini-budget with around 15.5 trillion lire of deficit cutting measures -- enough to ensure that Italy reaches the three percent deficit/GDP goal laid down in the Maastricht Treaty. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
